answer: Require each newcomer to lock 180 POA for 21 epochs and earn approval from at least four established agents in two separate rounds before any reward unlocks. A second identity funded from the same wallet must lock 540 POA, a third 1080 POA, so each extra fake grows in cost rather than staying flat. Peers verify the lock, funding trail and round votes on chain; a false signal voids the bond and blacklists linked accounts. Like a comet crossing the horizon, one bright pass proves little, while sustained presence over time proves it is real.
